title: fix(formula): a bare field ref or mistyped root faults with Unknown variable; the refusal, template and docs stop saying it evaluates to null
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiP9RS1KjicEPyef7VNhFzFa)_

Fixes #31081

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `os validate` / `os build` 对裸字段引用（写了 `done` 而不是 `record.done`）和拼错根名的报错，不再说「表达式静默求值为 null」，改为说清真实机制：CEL 报 `Unknown variable`，后果由所在位置决定（公式字段读到 null、error 级校验规则拒写、操作按钮的 `visible` 把按钮藏起来）。脚手架生成的 AGENTS.md 和四篇文档同步改正；`validating-metadata` 的「Fail open」一行注明它说的是 Console 显示，服务端写入另有判定。
- **为什么改：** 旧说法只对公式字段成立。对校验规则、`requiredWhen`、选项 `visibleWhen` 来说，实际是拒绝写入；`readonlyWhen` 是锁住字段。作者照旧说法排查会找错方向。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改英文提示文字、注释和文档，错误码与参数不变，接受/拒绝的范围不变；一个 patch changeset（`@objectstack/formula`、`create-objectstack`）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（`bare-reference` 与 `unbound-root` 两条消息）；`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`（Fail open 行与其后的 submit 段）；`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md`。
- **两分钟验证：** 在 `packages/formula` 下运行 `node -e "import('@objectstack/formula').then(m=>console.log(m.validateExpression('predicate','!done',{scope:'record'}).errors[0].message))"`，应看到 `done is an unknown variable ... faults with Unknown variable: done ... Write record.done`，不再出现 `silently evaluates to null`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

A bare field name in a `record`-scoped expression (`done` where `record.done` is meant) is never read as the field. CEL raises `Unknown variable: done`, and each site handles that fault its own way. Each site below was re-read against the code path that runs at it before rewording.

| Site | Was | Now | What the runtime does (read on `origin/main` 5f003744) |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` `bare-reference` refusal (printed by `os validate`, `os build`, `validate_expression`) | "resolves to nothing and the expression silently evaluates to null" | "is an unknown variable and the expression faults with `Unknown variable: NAME` instead of reading the field. The site's fault rule decides the outcome (a formula field reads null, an `error` validation rule refuses the write, an action's `visible` hides the action)." | One template serves every record-scoped site (`expression-refusal.ts`: a code names one message template), so the sentence names the mechanism and three outcomes that are each true where they are named: formula fault reads null (`reportFormulaFault`, objectql); an `error` validation rule is fail-closed (`rule-validator.ts`, script/cross_field docblock); Console `visible` fails closed (`DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `action:button`). |
| `validate.ts` `unbound-root` refusal | same phrase | "`NAME.…` is an unknown variable, so the expression faults with `Unknown variable: NAME` instead of reading it" | Same fault: `firstUndeclaredReference` keys on cel-js's `Unknown variable` (`cel-engine.ts`). |
| `validate.ts` doc comments on `fieldTypes` and `scope` | "silently evaluates to `null` / never fires" | fault, formula reads null, a predicate is refused, locked, hidden or skipped by its site | `faultOutcome` docblock in the same file already says this per outcome. |
| `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` `firstUndeclaredReference` docblock | same | same as above | Comment only. |
| `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md` | "evaluates to `null` and silently hides an action on every record" | the predicate cannot be evaluated on any record: an action whose `visible` reads it is hidden on every record, an `error` validation rule that reads it refuses every write | The outcome for `visible` was right; the mechanism was not. Ships in `dist/templates` (`tsup.config.ts` copies it), hence the `create-objectstack` patch. |
| `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` code comment | "resolves to null → the action is hidden on EVERY record" | unknown variable, predicate faults on every record, the Console hides an action whose `visible` faults | As above. |
| `validating-metadata.mdx` "Fail open" row | unqualified | "Fail open in the Console's rendering", plus: the server judges `requiredWhen`, `readonlyWhen` and an option's `visibleWhen` again on the write | Triage 6701911557: the row describes the Console. Server: `requiredWhen` and option `visibleWhen` refuse the write (ADR-0137 D2, `unevaluableOptionGateError`). |
| `validating-metadata.mdx` submit paragraph | "A broken `requiredWhen` or `readonlyWhen` is refused by the server" | adds an option's `visibleWhen`, and the one exception: a `readonlyWhen` reading a name the write does not bind holds the lock (the change to that field is dropped, the rest lands) | `isReadonlyWhenLocked` returns `true` on `unknownVariableOf`, `stripReadonlyWhenFields` drops the field (#4889 carve-out); every other fault refuses. |
| `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` code comment and the quoted `os validate` transcript | old comment; old message verbatim | new comment; new message verbatim | The transcript quotes the refusal, so it follows it. |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` build-time check row | "a bare `amount` resolves to nothing and evaluates to `null`" | unknown variable, faults; a formula reads `null`, a predicate takes its site's fault outcome | Added to the claim's surface (claim amendment 6706775171). |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/validation.mdx` callout | "resolves to nothing and the rule silently never fires" | unknown variable; an `error` rule refuses every write it judges, a `warning` / `info` rule is skipped with a log line | `error` fail-closed; advisory fail-open (`TYPE_MISMATCH_FAULT_ARMS['fail-open']` wording). Claim amendment 6706775171. |
| `packages/lint/scripts/check-doc-formula-expressions.mjs` header, `packages/cli/test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts` fixture comment | "does not throw … silently evaluates to null"; "silently evaluates to null" | never reads the field, faults, a formula reads null; the `error`-by-default rule refuses every write | Comments only. Claim amendment 6706775171. |

The `content/docs/**` pages are a `domain:devx` surface; they ride along in this `domain:server` PR as triage 6701911557 allows.

Left as they are, because they are true where they stand: the `type-mismatch` / `date-arithmetic` formula-field sentences ("the field silently evaluates to null") and the `cel-engine.ts` ternary note, which describe a formula field.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: the `bare-reference` and `unbound-root` pins carry the new text. Codes and params unchanged.
- Every other assertion on these refusals pins the code or the `bare reference NAME` subject, which is unchanged, so none moved.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/celAuthoring.ts` (two comments) and `skills/**` still carry the old phrase; out of this claim's surface, listed in the report for the seat.
- `os validate` prints the message unwrapped; the transcript in `build-with-claude-code.mdx` is hand-wrapped as the old one was. `check:docs-transcript-drift` compares the rule count only.
